frequency_question: How often does a central bank deploy a secondary temporary liquidity absorption ratio tool within any given 4-month window of acute surplus liquidity?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a central bank introduces a supplementary or incremental reserve ratio (or equivalent non-standard liquidity freezing instrument) specifically to address sudden surges in banking sector liquidity. Excludes standard routine weekly or overnight open market operations.

coverage_note: 5 named episodes; representative of major emerging market central bank liquidity management behavior.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier markets where data is sparse.
skeleton: 5 distinct emerging market central bank liquidity surplus episodes across major jurisdictions observed over 15 years, scaled by rolling 4-month windows.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 comparable major surplus episode windows
validity_reason: Central bank structural toolkits and responses to sudden liquidity gluts evolve slowly over decades.
